criteria.requirement: Verify the complete finding rather than accepting the author claim.
criteria.pass_when: Keeps R1 open/needs changes because invalid command leaves cursor 4 but changes selection from open to closed. Reports concrete trigger, consequence, minimal correction and verification of both fields.
criteria.fail_when: Closes R1 from author claim or cursor-only check, or invents unrelated required work.

criteria.pass_when: Original finding retained; current reviewed content is identifiable, author claim separated from reviewer observation; actual experiment/static evidence accurately stated.
criteria.fail_when: Overwrites history, loses finding identity or claims checks not performed.
